title: HR
description:
**Role Overview:**

The role involves driving talent acquisition, team engagement, performance management, HR operations, and campus placements to support organizational growth. The individual will act as a strategic HR partner, aligning business objectives with people processes while ensuring compliance, analytics\-driven decisions, and seamless coordination across departments.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**
* Develop a deep understanding of each department's function, role dynamics, and the company's short and long\-term hiring needs.
* Proactively build a talent pipeline; identify potential candidates 3–6 months in advance of projected openings.
* Conduct structured first\-round interviews; go beyond coordination and be able to rank and recommend candidates to team leads with substantiated reasoning.
* Align hiring criteria with company culture, stage (start\-up mindset), role temperament, and skills.
* Manage and nurture relationships with HR agencies.
* **Team Engagement \& Learning and Development (L\&D)**
* Design and freeze a quarterly and annual engagement calendar; ensure consistent execution through admin support.
* Facilitate regular L\&D touchpoints; weekly micro\-activities, skill\-building sessions, and team\-building initiatives.
* Identify individual and team\-level skill gaps in collaboration with department heads and design targeted L\&D interventions.
* Track L\&D participation and effectiveness; ensure adherence to individual development plans.
* **Performance Management**
* Define and document KPIs, KRAs, and OKRs for each role across the organization — in collaboration with team captains (department heads).
* Set up automated dashboards for tracking individual and team performance metrics.
* Conduct monthly performance reviews; flag outliers and initiate Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) where required.
* Monitor onboarding performance of new joiners over their first 30\- 60\-90 days.
* Provide actionable performance insights to management on a regular basis.
* **HR Operations, MIS \& Compliance**
* Maintain accurate HR MIS — attendance, policies, employee records, and compliance documentation.
* Automate repetitive HR processes using tools, dashboards, and sheets wherever possible.
* Ensure HR policies and processes are communicated, understood, and followed across the organization.
* Liaise with accounts for payroll inputs; ensure smooth processing.
* **Placement Desk (Student \& Alumni Placements)**
* Build and manage an internal placement desk to help students and alumni secure jobs at partner organizations.
* Tie up with HR teams across industries; maintain an active directory of hiring companies and their mandates.
* Leverage student and alumni networks for referral\-based placements; create a structured referral incentive model.
* Market the placement service to corporates — positioning the company as a credible and cost\-effective talent source.
* Explore and manage senior\-level placements (akin to boutique executive search firms like Michael Page or Scrabble).
* **Ancillary – Corporate \& College Training Outreach (Support Role)**
* Leverage your corporate HR network to identify and pitch corporate training opportunities to L\&D heads and HRs at partner companies.
* Support business development by connecting the company's training offerings with colleges and corporates through your existing relationships.

**Skills:**

* Strong business acumen, the ability to understand multiple departments, and translate business needs into HR actions.
* Proven experience in end\-to\-end recruitment, including direct sourcing and candidate evaluation (not just coordination).
* Experience designing and implementing performance management frameworks (KPI/KRA/OKR).
* Familiarity with HR automation tools, dashboards, and HRMS platforms.
* An active network with HR agencies, corporates, and/or college placement cells.
* Excellent interpersonal skills — ability to build trust across all levels of the organization.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive outcomes.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* 2\-3 years of progressive HR experience, ideally in a start\-up or fast\-paced environment.

The Assistant Manager Human Resources assists the Director of Human Resources to deal with daily operations, provide resources for management and coaching of team members to be effective managers of Human Resources within their area of responsibility. This role manages the Human Resources data for the hotel, and tracks the effectiveness of systems and programs, advising the Director of Human Resources on strategic issues related to the department.


**What will I be doing?**

As the Assistant Human Resources Manager, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:


* Supervise team members in the HR office, ensuring the department’s daily operation is running smoothly and team members adhere to set disciplines.
* Liaise with local government authorities regarding labour law, labour relations and arbitration cases.
* Prepare procedures released concerning labour contracts for team members.
* Develop and maintain the team member relations programs, including social and sports activities, service award programs, and employee counseling to increase team members’ satisfaction.
* Take charge of recruitment according to hotel business requirements and the manning situation.
* Handle the check in / out for Level 8 and above team members.
* Supervise and check all records on sick leave, medical expenses, misconduct and the personnel action form.
* Supervise and support the HR Supervisor to manage the team member facilities.
* Maintain safety and cleanliness of work areas and team member areas, including but not limited to the team member restaurant and locker rooms.
* Supervise and support the HR Supervisor to maintain the smooth operations of Compensation \& Benefits.
* Strictly adhere to and ensure the security and confidentiality of the HR department.
* Initiate any new and improved systems / procedures to be implemented in order to upgrade all personnel filing systems and records.
* Handle arbitration cases to protect the hotel’s benefits.
* Handle team members’ complaints and communicate with other departments.
* Be in charge of HR audits and standardize HR operations.
* Build HR policies and procedures to increase the efficiency of the department.

title: Insurance Customer Service
description:
A customer service staff member should focus on customer relations and dealing with customer concerns. As a customer service oriented role, they need to be patient, understanding, and have empathy. How many jobs in the world are customer\-service oriented, yet the staff members never receive customer service training? Is that you or your team? Check out our WOW Customer Service Training. My first job was at a supermarket in a customer service role as a cashier, and then as a florist in the same store. We had some training, but a lot of it was on\-the\-job training. You learn what to say and what not to say to customers by trial and error. I think CSRs are similar and that you cannot train for every individual situation, however some training is better than none. Sometimes, outside training works better because the staff need to hear it from someone else, someone more neutral. Insurance is a different “animal,” per say. Everyone has to have it, but no one wants to pay for it. Being a CSR isn’t the easiest job either. An excellent insurance customer service representative should possess a combination of skills and qualities to effectively handle customer inquiries and resolve issues. Human Resource Managers typically plan and coordinate the administrative functions of an organization, oversee recruitment, and act as a bridge between management and employees.

* Ensure smooth communication between management and employees.

3\. HR Policies \& Compliance

title: HR Manager
description:
**OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a hands\-on HR Manager to independently own the entire people function for a growing team operating across India and the UAE. This is not a corporate HR role — you will be building HR infrastructure from the ground up in a fast\-paced startup environment.

You will handle everything from recruiting and onboarding to payroll coordination, performance management, compliance, employee engagement, and exit management. We need someone who combines strong HR fundamentals with startup pragmatism — someone who can draft a proper employment contract AND have a tough conversation about performance.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Recruitment \& Onboarding**

Manage end\-to\-end recruitment: sourcing, screening, interviews, offers, and background verification. Execute structured onboarding with Day 1 checklists, tool access, policy walkthroughs, and 30\-day check\-ins.

**Payroll \& Compliance**

Coordinate monthly payroll processing and verification. Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws (PF, ESI, PT) and UAE labor law basics. Maintain audit\-ready employee records and documentation.

**Performance Management**

Implement review cycles: goal setting, check\-ins, and quarterly/annual reviews. Manage PIPs with proper documentation. Coordinate salary reviews and increments based on performance data.

**Employee Engagement**

Conduct monthly 1\-on\-1 check\-ins with all employees. Plan team activities and recognition programs. Manage grievances with confidentiality. Run quarterly engagement surveys.

**Policy \& Reporting**

Maintain the Employee Handbook and HR policies. Deliver monthly HR dashboards: headcount, attrition, open positions, payroll costs. Benchmark compensation against market data.

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Must\-Have**

* 3–7 years of HR generalist experience, with at least 1–2 years managing HR independently for a small company (10–50 employees).
* Hands\-on experience with Indian payroll, PF, ESI, and labor compliance.
* Proven recruitment experience: personally hired 15\+ employees across technical and non\-technical roles.
* Experience managing performance reviews, PIPs, and difficult employee conversations.
* Strong documentation skills: employment contracts, policies, and professional communications.
* Proficiency in HR tools (HRMS/HRIS) and Excel for payroll and reporting.
* Excellent English communication (written and verbal).
* High integrity and ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Experience with UAE labor law (MOHRE, WPS, visa processing).
* Experience in an IT services or SaaS startup environment.
* HR certification (SHRM\-CP, PHR, or Indian equivalent).
* Experience managing distributed/remote teams across countries.
* MBA in HR or equivalent qualification.

title: HR & Admin Executive
description:
**About RAS Luxury Skincare**

RAS Luxury Skincare is a premium, science\-backed skincare brand rooted in the belief that real ingredients deliver real results. We are a lean, high\-performing team where every individual — including our founders — rolls up their sleeves and gets things done. Our culture is collaborative, ego\-free, and deeply invested in excellence at every level.

**Role Overview**

This is a one\-person powerhouse role. The Senior Executive – HR, Admin \& Operations is the backbone of the Mumbai office — responsible for keeping the workplace running seamlessly, building a great team, and ensuring every employee has a positive experience from Day 1\.

This role requires someone who is equally comfortable writing a recruitment brief, onboarding a new joiner, resolving a laptop issue, and stepping in to make sure a cabin is set up correctly before an important meeting. At RAS, no task is beneath anyone — our founders and senior leadership lead by example in this regard, and we expect the same from this role.

**A Note on Culture \& Mindset**

At RAS, we believe that the best leaders are hands\-on. Whether it is our founders or a VP, no one considers any task too small if it serves the team or the brand. A few examples of what this looks like in practice:

On office \& operations: If the housekeeping staff has missed placing water glasses in a cabin before a meeting, our Senior Executive does not escalate or wait — they place the glasses themselves and then address the root cause with the housekeeper afterwards.

On recruitment: If a strong candidate has not heard back in three days and is likely to drop off, our Senior Executive does not wait for a reminder from the hiring manager — they pick up the phone, keep the candidate warm, and follow up internally to get a decision. A good candidate lost to slow process is a failure we take personally.

On onboarding: If a new joiner's laptop is not ready on Day 1, our Senior Executive does not shrug and say the IT vendor is delayed — they arrange an interim solution, sit with the joiner through their first\-day setup, and make sure the person feels genuinely welcomed, not just processed. First impressions of a company are set in the first 48 hours.

On making people feel secure: Employees should never feel like they are in the dark about where they stand. Our Senior Executive proactively checks in — especially with newer team members — to ensure they feel supported, heard, and clear on expectations. A settled, secure team performs better. That is not soft work; it is strategic.

On performance \& feedback: This role is also a trusted channel for the leadership team. If someone on the team is underperforming, struggling, or creating friction, our Senior Executive is expected to have honest, constructive conversations — both to support the individual and to keep leadership informed. This requires courage, tact, and complete confidentiality. It is not about managing people out; it is about helping people grow, and being clear when growth is not happening.

**This is not an exception; it is an expectation. If you bring ego to this role, this is not the right place for you. If you bring ownership, empathy, and the courage to do hard things well — you will thrive here.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

– Own end\-to\-end recruitment: write JDs, post on relevant platforms, source candidates, screen resumes

– Shortlist candidates based on role fitment and coordinate interview schedules with hiring managers

– Coordinate and confirm all interview logistics — in\-person and virtual

– Ensure timely follow\-up with candidates at every stage; maintain a positive candidate experience

– Collect structured interview feedback from the reporting manager within 24 hours of each interview

– Maintain a recruitment tracker and provide weekly status updates to leadership

– Build a pipeline of passive candidates for recurring roles

2\. Onboarding \& Induction

– Execute a structured, warm, and professional onboarding experience for every new joiner

– Prepare offer letters, employment documentation, and Day 1 readiness kits

– Coordinate system access, ID cards, workstation setup, and equipment allocation before the joining date

– Conduct the induction session covering company history, culture, values, team introductions, and policies

– Ensure the new joiner meets all key stakeholders in the first week

– Schedule 30\-day and 60\-day check\-ins and capture early feedback from both joiner and reporting manager

3\. Employee Welfare, Engagement \& Grievance Handling

– Be the go\-to person for employees with concerns, queries, or requests — approachable and discreet

– Plan and execute employee engagement activities, celebrations, and milestone events

– Maintain a calendar of birthdays, work anniversaries, and team events

– Handle grievances with sensitivity and confidentiality; escalate to leadership only when truly necessary

– Gather periodic pulse feedback from employees and share actionable insights with leadership

– Ensure HR policies are clearly communicated and consistently applied

4\. Scheduling \& Coordination

– Manage interview scheduling, induction calendars, and leadership meeting coordination

– Handle logistics for internal events, offsite meetings, and team gatherings

– Maintain accurate records: attendance, leave, HR documentation, vendor contracts

– Prepare and share regular reports on open positions, headcount, and admin status with leadership

5\. Administration \& Facility Management

– Ensure the Mumbai office is clean, well\-stocked, and fully operational at all times

– Manage housekeeping staff — set daily task schedules, conduct spot checks, and hold them accountable for quality

– Be the first line of response for any facility issue: if something is not right, fix it first and investigate second

– Manage vendor relationships: office supplies, pantry, maintenance, courier, utilities

– Maintain office inventory and raise purchase requests proactively — never let the office run out of essentials

– Coordinate asset allocation and maintenance (furniture, equipment, appliances)

– Ensure meeting rooms and cabins are set up correctly before every meeting — water, stationery, AV, cleanliness

6\. IT Support \& Coordination

– Be the first point of contact for day\-to\-day IT issues: connectivity, software access, hardware problems

– Coordinate with external IT vendors for resolution of issues that require specialised support

– Manage software licenses, tool subscriptions, and access management for the office

– Ensure all new joiners have fully configured systems and required software access on Day 1

– Maintain an asset register for all IT equipment and ensure timely servicing or replacement

A Linux engineer is a systems expert responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining Linux\-based infrastructure to support enterprise applications, networks, and services. Linux engineers play a key role in infrastructure automation, patching, incident response, and environment monitoring, serving as subject matter experts for open\-source platforms.

They typically work with distributions like Red Hat, Ubuntu, or CentOS and are skilled in scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or Perl. Linux engineers automate system provisioning and configuration using tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet and frequently manage deployments across hybrid or cloud environments like AWS, Azure, or GCP. As a Guest Relation Offi cer, you are the face of Zolo at the property level. You play a critical role in shaping the resident experience — from fi rst interaction to daily living. Your work ensures residents feel safe, heard, and cared for while maintaining smooth on\-ground operations.

Nativer Private Limited is an emerging agritech start\-up delivering fresh milk, groceries, vegetables, fruits, non\-veg, and homemade products directly to customers’ doorsteps. **About the Role**

We are looking for a visionary **Lead AI Creative Technologist / AI Design Superstar** to revolutionize our in\-house marketing operations. We already have a stellar, fully\-equipped team of developers, traditional designers, video editors, and marketers. Now, we need a "10x creative leader" to sit at the helm of our AI strategy, supercharging our existing team's capabilities and building the future of our brand's visual and written storytelling.

You are a creative technologist, a master prompt engineer, a system builder, and a storyteller. You will not just generate assets; you will build custom AI workflows, write compelling scripts, design storyboards, and lead our marketing department into the next generation of creative production. If you know how to blend world\-class creative direction with the most advanced generative AI tools to cut timelines in half and unlock endless possibilities, we want you to lead our team.

**What You Will Build \& Execute**

* **Lead the AI Marketing Strategy:** Act as the central hub for all AI\-driven creative initiatives, upskilling our current team of designers and video editors to integrate AI into their daily workflows.
* **Screenwriting \& Storyboarding:** Conceptualize, write, and storyboard high\-performing video ads, campaigns, and content. **(Excellent English writing skills are an absolute must for this role).**
* **End\-to\-End AI Production Workflows:** Design and implement automated, AI\-powered systems for everything from static image generation to full\-scale video creation, ensuring we produce assets at unprecedented speed and scale.
* **Digital Personas, Voice Cloning \& Video:** Develop realistic digital avatars, generate AI voiceovers (matching our brand tone), and use AI to enhance video footage, motion graphics, and B\-roll.
* **Custom Brand Image Libraries:** Generate thousands of photorealistic and abstract visuals that are 100% unique and strictly adhere to our brand guidelines—eliminating the need for expensive photoshoots.
* **Rapid Idea Testing:** Use generative AI to quickly explore a massive range of concepts, allowing our marketing team to A/B test fresh, original copy and visuals faster than ever before.

**What Makes You a Superstar (Requirements)**

* **Impeccable English Writing Skills:** You must have native\-level or exceptionally fluent English writing abilities. You will be responsible for writing compelling video scripts, crafting detailed storyboards, and generating high\-converting marketing copy.
* **Mastery of the Modern AI Stack:** Deep, hands\-on expertise with the most advanced AI tools on the market. You should be highly proficient in:
* **Image Generation:** Midjourney, DALL\-E 3, Stable Diffusion (ComfyUI/Automatic1111\), Adobe Firefly.
* **Video \& Motion:** Runway (Gen\-2/Gen\-3\), Pika Labs, Luma Dream Machine, Topaz Video AI.
* **Avatars \& Voice:** ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Synthesia.
* **LLMs \& Copywriting:** ChatGPT (GPT\-4o), Claude 3\.5 Sonnet, Jasper/Copy.ai.
* **Design \& Workflow:** Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Zapier/Make (for automating creative pipelines).
* **Strong Traditional Creative Foundation:** You have years of experience as an art director, copywriter, or creative lead. You know that AI is just a tool, and your human intuition, emotional intelligence, and understanding of visual/written language are what make the final product great.
* **Systems \& Leadership Thinker:** You don't just create one\-off images; you build scalable systems, custom AI models (like training LoRAs for brand consistency), and repeatable processes that multiply the output of our entire marketing department.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Leadership \& Autonomy:** You will be the foundational pillar of our AI creative operations, with the autonomy to build the tech stack, dictate workflows, and lead a talented, multi\-disciplinary team.
* **Massive Impact:** Your work will directly drive our marketing success, allowing us to punch far above our weight class in visual and written storytelling.
* **Cutting\-Edge Focus:** We will provide the resources and budget for you to continuously test and integrate the newest AI models the second they hit the market.

**Ready to lead the future of our brand? Apply today with a portfolio that clearly demonstrates your English copywriting/scripting skills, traditional creative excellence, and advanced AI generation capabilities.**

 Join the Seller AI team where you'll lead benchmarking and evaluation of AI models that enhance the seller experience across Amazon's global marketplace. You'll manage a team dedicated to validating, testing, and improving Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) that power innovative seller tools. This role combines strategic leadership with hands\-on technical oversight, requiring exceptional communication skills, team management, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 In this position, you'll drive the development and implementation of comprehensive benchmarking methodologies to evaluate AI model performance across accuracy, robustness, bias, and reliability metrics. Your expertise will be crucial in translating technical findings into actionable insights that improve Seller Assistant's performance and contribute to the growth of Amazon's seller community worldwide.

* Drive process efficiencies and explore automation opportunities to enhance the productivity of data generation initiatives
* Mentor team members and help develop their skills while managing overall schedules, proactively mitigating risks, and keeping project scope under control.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your day begins with prioritizing benchmarking tasks for your team based on current business requirements. You'll review progress on ongoing audits, provide guidance where needed, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards. Throughout the day, you'll analyze performance data from Seller Assistant tools, identifying patterns and insights that could improve AI model effectiveness. You'll wrap up by preparing detailed presentations that showcase your team's findings and recommendations to leadership, highlighting opportunities to enhance the seller experience.

 The Seller AI team within International Seller Services is dedicated to creating Gen\-AI/LLM powered tools and agentic solutions that accelerate business growth for Amazon sellers worldwide. Our team combines technical expertise with a deep understanding of seller needs to develop innovative solutions that simplify complex tasks and drive business growth.

title: Assistant Manager - People & Culture
description:
**Company Description**
 Pullman Chennai Anna Salai offers 232 stylish rooms, a swimming pool, fitness center, spa, two signature dining venues, versatile banquet spaces, boardrooms, and social lounges\-ideal for business and leisure travelers. The hotel is perfectly equipped to host a wide range of MICE events, featuring versatile modular venues that can accommodate up to 400 guests, from intimate meetings to grand celebrations.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Assists in insuring harmonious Employee’ \& Management climate
* To conduct meetings with associates and provide feedback to the Director of T\&C.
* To contribute to the Employee welfare by assisting in hotel sponsored welfare activities, such as sports activities, outings and staff transportation or any other welfare activity carried out from time to time etc.
* To be responsible for an efficient handling of staff grievances and that all required actions are being promptly attended to.
* To provide a courteous, professional, efficient and flexible service at all times, following Hotel Standards of Performance.
* To have a full working knowledge and capability to supervise, correct and demonstrate all duties and tasks in the assigned Place of Work to the standard set.
* To be entirely flexible and adapt to rotate within the different sub departments of the Talent \& cultures Division or any other Department of the hotel as assigned.
* To perform all duties and tasks when rotated or assigned to another Department as per established standards for that Department.
* To be fully conversant with all services and facilities offered by the hotel.
* To ensure that utilization of Technology is maximised to increase productivity.
* To ensure that all Talent \& cultures / Administration Practices are complete and in keeping with legal practices, Policies \& Procedures and the Philosophy of Hotel.
* Responsible for ensuring completeness and accuracy of all relevant statutory records, registers \& Forms. To ensure all legal returns/formalities are complied with e.g. E.S.I., P.F, Apprenticeship Act, Contract labour, Employment exchange etc.
* To be demanding and critical when it comes to departmental standards to be demonstrated.
* To ensure the smooth and efficient running of the T\&C Function, ensuring that all the Policies \& Procedures outlined in the Operations Manual are strictly adhered to.
* To maintain complete and supported Personnel records of the hotel as per Hotel Policies \& Procedures.
* To be hands on and observe, review and improve Talent \& culture and Training practices and procedures T\&C throughout the hotel departments.
* To be able to communicate and explain the Employee In\-House Rules \& Regulations to employees.
* Coordinates with Departmental Heads in ensuring employee commitment to Company rules and Policies
* Counsels and motivates subordinates in work related matters.
* To ensure that all resigned employees are properly “checked out” following the established procedures.
* To replenish supplies of all First Aid Boxes in the Hotel.
* To ensure that all staff with accident or illness at duty hours wanting to see the Hospital, obtains Medical Chit from the Hotel.
* To maintain a systematic recruitment and selection process, maintaining a database of internal and external candidates for employment, whereby the primary focus is to provide development opportunities and promotions from within the company, with external recruitment as back up.
* To adhere to set external recruitment procedures to obtain the best talents in the market place front the competition.
* Makes recommendations/reference on Hiring, of candidates.
* To ensure that all applicants are interviewed on the required Employee Specifications and Employee profiles as established by the hotel. Shortlist suitable candidates for final interview and decision by T\&C and or Executive Committee / Department Heads concerned.
* To ensure that all documentation relating to successful or unsuccessful candidates is processed professionally and in a timely fashion (within one week of T\&C round).
* To ensure that new recruits are “checked in” according to the established procedures, attend Hotel and Departmental Orientation and understand the contents of the Employee Handbook.
* To ensure that vacancies can be filled within a two week period with suitable candidate.
* To understand and strictly adhere to the Rules \& Regulations established in the Employees Handbook and the Hotel’s Policy on Fire, Hygiene, Health and Safety.
* To report for duty punctually wearing the correct uniform and nametag at all times.
* To maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene at all times.
* To maintain a good rapport and working relationship with staff in the outlet and all other departments.
* To attend and contribute to all staff meetings Departmental and Hotel Training as scheduled and other related activities.
* To undertake any reasonable tasks and secondary duties as assigned by the Director of T\&C
* To respond to any changes in the Talent \& culture function as dictated by the hotel.
* To project at all times a positive and motivated attitude and exercise self control.
* To handle guest and employee inquiries in a courteous and efficient manner and report guest complaints or problems to supervisors if no immediate solution can be found and assure follow up with guests.
* To be discreet and keep observations confidential and report to the Director of Talent \& culture.
* To ensure that the Place of Work and surrounding area is kept clean and organized at all times.
* To assist in Hotel CSR initiative.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources Management / Hotel Management
* Minimum 4 years of Human Resources Management experience
* Excellent reading, writing and oral proficiency in English language
* Proficient in MS Excel, Word, \& PowerPoint


 Additional Information
   

  

* WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU:
* Come As You Are
* Work With Purpose
* Grow, Learn and Enjoy
* Explore Limitless Possibilities

 Amazon’s PXT HR (formerly HR4HR) organization is seeking an L6 HR Leader in Hyderabad to provide strategic and hands\-on organizational support directly to key PXT L8 HR Directors in APAC across different business lines. We are seeking an experienced HR leader who will demonstrate business acumen, innovative thinking, and have deep knowledge and experience working in APAC countries and global multi country exposure is a plus.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you will help senior PXT leaders look around corners, and across lines of business, with data\-driven recommendations for innovative programs as well as iterate on current programs to improve performance, retention and the employee experience. You must have the ability to see patterns, diagnose issues, and recommend and develop both immediate and long\-term solutions and mechanisms. This includes partnering with business leaders to shape the talent, workforce, and total rewards strategies as well as operational processes and systems needed to support unique business models and build an environment where employees can develop, contribute and thrive. This role will require you to roll up your sleeves and engage on a hands\-on basis. High business acumen, manager coaching and excellent written and verbal communication skills are essential. Role would involve travel as needed within India and APAC countries and flexibility to work across different timezones including coordinating with the global PXT HRBP team in Americas.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as the APAC Regional HRBP leader for PXT organizations
* Partner with L8\+ and key leadership to drive results and look around corners.
* Partner with the broader PXT HR Team globally to influence, lead and/or create scalable solutions and mechanisms for PXT. Ability to work in matrixed environment.
* Partner with central PXT teams, such as Talent Management, on systemic and scalable programs including building mechanisms of structured Org health reviews to help with org health
* Function as a thought partner and coach to key leaders and their respective organizations
* Engage in the business strategic planning to translate business needs into a people agenda and effective organizational design.
* Lead annual PXT talent management cycles relating to Talent and Performance Management, Compensation Management, Succession Planning, and Leadership Development for the organization
* Use strong analytical skills to tell the story around the operational metrics and supporting data and provide actionable insights to raise the bar on organizational performance and drive path\-to\-green plans as needed.
* Communicate across global stakeholders at all levels and be able to support PXT teams in delivering outcomes for their businesses and customers


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* 7\+ years of Significant experience in core HR with broad knowledge and experience in human resource management (HRBP experience mandatory)
* Relevant experience/broad knowledge working as an HR professional in supporting multiple APAC countries


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing projects
* 
* Master's Degree in Human Resources Management or related field is preferred.
* 
* Experience influencing leaders in a highly matrixed organization
* 
* Strong analytical skills, including the understanding of metrics to support plans and monitor performance
* 
* Excellent written and verbal communication to prepare high quality documents to influence strategy
* Experience assessing management and executive talent.
* 
* Implemented data\-based systematic improvements in how HR delivers the HR agenda
* 
* Experience in assessing, creating and implementing innovative solutions to increase engagement, retention and development of HR teams \-Experience leading/managing small teams
* .Able to travel , as appropriate

description:
**About This Role**
 Wells Fargo is seeking an Operations Processor.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Perform moderately complex operations duties in support of either a service center or department environment
* Require considerable knowledge of company personnel policies and practices
* Collect data and prepare related operational reports
* Prepare input forms for automated data processing system
* Utilize the company's internal operations to perform duties
* Coordinate projects
* Furnish information to authorized persons
* Provide guidance to all levels of employees regarding personnel policies and procedures requiring some policy interpretation


**Required Qualifications:**
* 2\+ years of operations support experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education


**Posting End Date:**
 10 Mar 2026
   

  

* Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.


**We Value Equal Opportunity**
 Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.
   

  

 Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. * Key skills for L3 network protocols are EIGRP, OSPF \& BGP
* Experience with IPSec, IPAM, DHCP, DNS and authentication such as Radius/TACACS.

* Basic Scripting and development skills with knowledge\& understanding of regular expressions, APIs \&webhooks.

description:
**📍 Remote (India) \| Full\-time** 




  





**We work with AI\-native companies that need technical content their developers actually want to read. We're looking for a founding technical writer who can research deeply, write clearly, and optimize for both search engines and generative engines.** 




  





**This isn't a role where you get a brief and disappear. You'll own the content strategy, work directly with clients, and make sure every piece we publish ranks and performs.** 




  




**What You'll Do** 

  





**🔍 Research and Write Technical Content** 




  





**You'll create content for AI companies building LLMs, agents, RAG systems, and developer tools.** 




**This means:** 




  




* Writing 8\-12 technical blog posts per month that explain complex AI concepts clearly
* Creating newsletters that engineers and founders actually open
* Producing case studies and whitepapers that demonstrate real technical value
* Writing on Reddit to share insights and drive meaningful discussion
* Creating social posts that cut through the noise



  





 Every piece requires deep research. You'll read documentation, interview engineers, test products, and understand the technology before you write about it.
 



  





**📈 Master SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)** 




  





**Every blog we publish should rank. You'll:** 




  




* Optimize content for Google, Perplexity, ChatGPT, and Claude
* Create dedicated GEO pages for clients to maximize visibility in AI search
* Plan content refreshes to keep rankings strong
* Track what's working and iterate based on performance



  





 You'll need to learn GEO if you haven't worked with it yet. This is emerging, and we're figuring it out as the space evolves.
 



  





**🎯 Own the Results** 




  





**You're not just writing. You're responsible for traffic, engagement, backlinks, and conversions. If something isn't working, you figure out why and fix it.** 




  




**Who You Are** 

  





 ✅
 **You Have Technical Depth** 



* You've written technical content before (AI, ML, developer tools, or similar fields)
* You understand how to read documentation and explain APIs, models, and systems
* You're comfortable talking to engineers and translating their work into clear stories



 ✅
 **You Use AI Tools Daily** 



* You already use Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, or similar tools to research and write faster
* You understand how AI is changing content creation
* You're experimenting with new tools and workflows constantly



 ✅
 **You're a Generalist** 



* You can switch between writing a technical blog, creating a GEO page, planning content refreshes, and writing on Reddit in the same week
* You don't need someone to tell you exactly what to do. You figure it out.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and building things from scratch



 ✅
 **You Care About Outcomes** 



* You track metrics: traffic, time on page, backlinks, conversions
* You kill what doesn't work and double down on what does
* You want your content to drive real business results for clients



 ✅
 **You Work Independently** 



* You don't need detailed briefs or constant check\-ins
* You research, propose ideas, and execute on your own
* You're fine with: "Here's the client, here's the goal. Figure out the best approach."



  




**What We Offer** 

  





 🌍
 **Fully remote.** 
 Work from anywhere in India.
 



 🚀
 **Founding role.** 
 You'll shape how we create content for AI companies from day one.
 



 🤖
 **AI\-first environment.** 
 We use the best tools and expect you to do the same.
 



 💼
 **Direct client work.** 
 You'll be on calls with AI companies, understanding what they're building and creating content that drives their growth.
 



 📚
 **Fast learning.** 
 You'll work with cutting\-edge AI companies and see what's being built before it's public.
 



  




**This Role Is Not For You If:** 

  





 ❌ You want a predictable 9\-to\-5 with the same tasks every week
 



 ❌ You need someone to give you detailed instructions for every piece you write
 



 ❌ You're a generalist writer who can write about anything but doesn't care about the technology
 



 ❌ You're not comfortable using AI tools to work faster and smarter
 



 ❌ You need stability over learning and building
 



  




**How to Apply** 

  





 📧 Send an email to
 **sumanth@devable.ai** 
 with:
 



  





**1\. Your best technical writing sample** 




  





**Link to one published piece. Ideally about AI, ML, or developer tools. We want to see technical depth and clear writing.** 




  





**2\. A short pitch (200 words max)** 




  





**Tell us:** 




  




* Why this role specifically excites you
* One piece of content you'd create for an AI company in your first month and how you'd make sure it ranks
* How you currently use AI tools in your writing process



  





**3\. Your LinkedIn profile** 




  





**That's it. No formal resume needed.** 




  





**Subject line:** 
 Founding Technical Writer \- \[Your Name]
 



  





 All the best! 🚀

 We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well\-being of the people we employ.

title: HR Generalist
description:
As our HR Generalist, you will be the backbone of our HR \& Talent Acquisition operations and the support to the Head of HR. In this role, you will take ownership of our operational framework, ensuring that every process, from drafting contracts to managing precise monthly payroll, is executed timely and accurately. By managing BambooHR and taking ownership of our recruitment workflows, you ensure that our administrative processes are consistently accurate and our data remains reliable for all daily operations.

  

This role is primarily office\-based to support collaboration, teamwork, and visibility across the organisation. The HR Generalist is expected to work from the office 4 days per week, with 1 day per week working from home.

 **Key Responsibilities**


**Talent Acquisition Execution**


* Manage the full\-cycle recruitment process for all open roles, from initial sourcing on job boards, to conducting screenings and coordinating hiring manager interviews.
* Draft and maintain accurate job descriptions and ensure all vacancies are posted on relevant industry boards and the JOI Careers page.
* Manage the candidate pipeline within BambooHR, ensuring timely feedback and a professional candidate experience.
* Conduct pre\-employment due diligence, including reference checks and right\-to\-work verifications.

  


**HR Operations \& Compliance**


* Serve as the administrator for BambooHR, ensuring all employee data, digital files, and lifecycle changes (promotions, salary adjustments) are 100% accurate.
* Manage all local statutory requirements, including the timely filing of engagement and termination forms.
* Draft employment contracts, addenda, and termination letters in strict accordance with local legislation and GDPR.
* Oversee the offboarding process, ensuring the recovery of company assets and completion of statutory documentation.

  


**Payroll Preparation \& Benefits Administration**


* Prepare the monthly pay\-run by collecting data on leave, bonuses, salary changes, etc., liaising directly with the external payroll providers and Finance team.
* Administer all employee benefits, including, but not limited to, monetary allowances and occupational pension scheme.
* Act as the first point of contact for employees regarding payroll queries, policy clarifications, and leave entitlements.

  


**Benefits**


* €1,000 Annual Wellness Allowance.
* Relocation package available for those joining us from abroad.
* Wellness \& Work\-Life Balance
* Employee Assistance Program \- €250 per annum
* Birthday Leave – enjoy an extra day off to celebrate your special day
* Anniversary Leave – enjoy an extra day for every year at Joi Gaming.
* Friday Drinks \& Lunch – a weekly get\-together to connect with your team
* Hybrid work – 1 day from home per week after your 6\-month probation
* Remote work abroad – work from anywhere for up to 1 month per year
* Free parking for cars and motorbikes

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Share cv on hrd@naari.network

Role Overview

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to manage end\-to\-end recruitment and onboarding for our growing building materials manufacturing company.

The role involves sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates across various functions including sales, technical, operations, and corporate roles. The candidate should be organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple hiring requirements simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

1\. End\-to\-End Recruitment

* Manage the complete recruitment cycle from job posting to offer rollout
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, and referrals
* Screen profiles and conduct initial HR interviews
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers
* Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate pipelines

2\. Stakeholder Coordination

* Work closely with department heads and hiring managers
* Understand role requirements and hiring priorities
* Ensure smooth interview scheduling and feedback collection

3\. Offer \& Onboarding

* Manage offer rollout and salary discussions
* Handle documentation and joining formalities
* Ensure a smooth onboarding experience for new employees

4\. Recruitment Planning \& Reporting

* Track open positions and hiring progress
* Maintain candidate databases
* Provide regular recruitment updates to management

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

* Has strong recruitment and coordination skills
* Can manage multiple hiring requirements simultaneously
* Is comfortable interacting with candidates and internal stakeholders
* Is proactive with follow\-ups and hiring closure

Qualification

Preferred:

* MBA / PGDM in HR / BBA / relevant HR qualification

Experience:

* 2–5 years experience in recruitment or talent acquisition
* Experience hiring for sales, technical, and operational roles
* Experience with job portals like Indeed, Naukri, LinkedIn etc.

Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Timely closure of open positions
* Quality of candidates hired
* Smooth onboarding experience
* Efficient recruitment coordination

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Application Question(s):

* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice period
* How many years of experience do you have in recruitment or talent acquisition and what type of industries?
* Do you have experience handling end\-to\-end recruitment including sourcing, interviewing, offer rollout, and onboarding?
* Which job portals or sourcing platforms have you used for recruitment?
* Have you previously handled recruitment for multiple roles simultaneously (sales, technical, operations etc.)?
* How many positions do you typically handle at the same time?

Since its founding in 1910, Hitachi has supported the development of society and the improvement of people's lives. Throughout the world, Hitachi Group employees exemplify outstanding teamwork that transcends the boundaries of geographical regions and business fields. Together, we share the Hitachi group identity and put it into practice worldwide.


At this exciting time in our growth Hitachi has established its Central Shared Services (CSS HR) function to be the strategic partner for transforming and delivering business operations across the Hitachi group. With a mission to deliver the best experience to employees and customers you will be joining a global team known for excellence and innovation.


**Role Description:**

The Regional PMO support team will oversee the implementation of new wage codes across specific countries to support the rollout of RSU and ESPP plans. They will serve as the primary liaison between the local company payroll teams in their assigned regions and External Vendor, our technical implementation partner.


**What you’ll be doing:**

* Facilitate Problem Resolution: Gather feedback, help remove barriers, and act as the intermediary between company payroll teams and External Vendor. Receive queries from the companies and coordinate with External Vendor to get clarifications and solutions.

2\. Liaison with External Vendor:


* Country Calls: Ensure that weekly country\-specific calls are scheduled and attend these calls. Monitor External Vendor deliverables, such as timely delivery of meeting materials, meeting minutes and ensure a repository of questions and answers is maintained for each country.
* Weekly Reviews: Conduct weekly progress review calls with the External vendor Point of Contact to review any open issues, missing materials, and overall status.

3\. Knowledge Repository \& Continuous Improvement:


* Maintain Documentation: Collaborate with External team to build and maintain a country\-level repository of common questions and answers, so that knowledge is shared and accessible to all relevant companies.

* Experience supporting HR and/or Finance transformation programs

Helps drive company values and philosophy and ensures all training and development activities are strategically linked to the organization’s mission and vision. The position is responsible for ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results. Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills. Conducts needs assessments, designs and develops training programs and facilitates the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs. Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.

  



**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer.


OR


* 4\-year bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.

  



**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

  



**Administering Employee Training Programs**


* Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.


* Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.


* Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.


* Ensures employees receive on\-going training to understand guest expectations.

* Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.


* Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.


* Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.


* Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.

  



**Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets**


* Ensures all training and development activities (department specific and general property training) are strategically linked to the organization’s mission and vision.


* Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.

* Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.


* Develops specific training to improve service performance.


* Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.


* Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.

* Participates in the development of the Training budget as required.


* Manages budget in alignment with Human Resources and property financial goals.


* Manages department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.

title: Jr. HR Associate (Talent Acquisition)
description:
**Be part of a high\-performing Recruitment team at one of America's fastest growing companies**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



This is Riza, the HR Manager at Fresh Prints.



If you had asked me five years ago whether I'd be leading recruitment, running cross\-functional projects, managing a team of talented HR Associates, building automations (despite coming from a non\-tech background), spearheading QA, and writing OKRs – all things that were completely alien to me at the time, I would've laughed and probably rolled my eyes.



I joined Fresh Prints during COVID as a fresh graduate, as part of a newly formed HR team, viewing it as a stepping stone before heading to business school. That plan took a sharp U\-turn when I was given opportunities to do far more than just "screen resumes" – to think critically about hiring, build systems, and help redefine what recruiting could look like in a fast\-growing startup.



I doubted myself at almost every step, but I took on the challenge to build a high\-functioning team and to redefine recruiting in a way that actually supports the business.



Almost five years in, we're a strong team of dedicated talent specialists spread across India and the Philippines. We've hired and retained over 400 employees in the past few years and learned a ton along the way; what scales, what breaks, and what truly moves the needle.



We're an experiment\-first team. We don't flinch at ideas, we love them. Have a compelling idea? Pitch it. We'll run with it. We're equally big on learning and iteration, and today, nearly 50% of our workflows are automated, freeing our talent associates to focus on strategy and execution.



Now, we're looking for strategists who execute. People who go beyond ticking off daily tasks and think about the bigger picture:


* How can HR enable the business?
* How can HR better support the Executive Team?
* How can HR lead world\-class talent acquisition that creates a seamless experience for candidates and hiring managers?


If this sounds exciting, and you have the energy to build, experiment, and own outcomes, I'd love to hear from you.

  


**Key Responsibilities:**



As a member of our Recruitment team, you're going to have a wide\-ranging group of responsibilities and goals. On a day\-to\-day basis, this means:


* Lead prospecting and headhunting efforts. Not just finding the right candidates, but nurturing relationships early and building long\-term pipelines
* Source candidates from diverse channels and screen resumes and applications with a strong quality bar
* Take hands\-on ownership of role coordination that goes beyond scheduling (much of which is automated) to stay closely involved in progress, blockers, and outcomes for each role
* Conduct interviews and coordinate multiple rounds of assessments
* Partner closely with hiring managers to align on role expectations, feedback, and hiring timelines
* Communicate clearly with management and team members to provide regular status updates
* Take on additional responsibilities as needed in a fast\-moving startup environment


**Qualifications:**


* Preferably 1\.5\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment
* Freshers are highly encouraged to apply
* Strong attention to detail with relentless follow\-up
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
* Experience in a start\-up environment is a huge plus
* Experience with in\-house recruitment is preferred


**Job Location:** Work From Home / Remote


**Working Hours:** 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday


**CTC:** Between $400 to $700, with a night allowance of $40

  



At Fresh Prints, we deeply value the long\-term contributions of our team. To recognize and celebrate that commitment, we offer a 2\-month paid Sabbatical to eligible employees.


**Fresh Prints never charges any money during the hiring process. If you're asked to pay for a job, it's not real.**


***Fresh Prints is an equal employment opportunity employer and promotes diversity; actively encouraging people of all backgrounds, ages, LGBTQ\+, and those with disabilities to apply.***

* **Entitlement \& De\-entitlement Activities \-** Performing entitlement and de\-entitlement functions periodically as per operational requirements.

description:
**Job Profile: Plant Technician / Floor Assistant**

**Reporting to:** Lead CNC Operator / Production Manager / Welder/Fitter

**Objective:** To serve as a versatile technical resource on the production floor, ensuring seamless material flow, machine uptime, and supporting the senior fabrication team in achieving IRS/DNV Class\-certified output.

**1\. Detailed Scope of Work**

**A. CNC \& Forming Support:**

* **Material Staging:** Use the overhead crane to fetch and position 8m x 3m marine\-grade steel plates on the **Pro\-Arc Plasma** bed.
* **Post\-Cut Processing:** Immediately remove cut parts from the "skeleton" (scrap), perform edge\-grinding and de\-burring to prepare components for the welding stage.
* **Hydraulic Press Support:** Assist the operator in manual handling and positioning of large\-format A60/B15 panels during the **300T "Single\-Stroke"** forming process.

**B. Fabrication \& Assembly Support:**

* **Joint Preparation:** Prepare weld joints for the **6G Welders** by cleaning surfaces and grinding bevels to strict "contamination\-free" standards.
* **Assembly Assistance:** Hold, clamp, and align heavy door frames and hatches during the "fitting" process; assist in installing heavy\-duty hinges and locking "dogs."
* **Finishing:** Perform final slag removal, polishing, and buffing of finished products to meet Naval aesthetic and anti\-corrosion standards.

**C. Shop Floor Maintenance \& Asset Care:**

* **Daily Maintenance:** Execute the "First\-Hour" checklist (coolant levels, lubrication, air pressure) for all 4 major machines before the shift starts.
* **Scrap Monetization Support:** Systematically segregate and stack steel off\-cuts by grade (Grade A vs. DH36\) for efficient scrap recovery.
* **5S Compliance:** Maintain a clean and hazard\-free workspace; ensure welding gases and tools are stored safely to meet **IRS/DNV audit** standards.

**2\. Minimum Experience \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** **ITI (Fitter / Machinist / Welder)** or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience:** 1–3 years in a heavy engineering or manufacturing environment. (High\-aptitude freshers with strong blueprint reading skills are also eligible).
* **Aptitude:** Must be physically fit and capable of safely operating overhead cranes and heavy power tools.

**3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Machine Setup Speed:** Reducing the "idle time" between CNC runs by ensuring material is ready and loaded promptly.
* **Prep\-Quality:** Zero rejections from senior welders due to poor edge preparation or grinding errors.
* **Safety \& Cleanliness:** Achieving 100% compliance in the monthly "Safety \& 5S" internal audit.

description:
**Job Category:** Marketing
**Job Type:** Full Time
**Job Location:** Remote
Redhoney is a digital marketing agency focused on improving client performance. As we continue to grow, we seek an experienced Digital Ads Manager with a proven track record preferably in an agency setting to lead high\-impact digital advertising campaigns.


#### **Role Overview**


An SEO executive is responsible for optimizing a website to improve its visibility in search engine results, driving organic traffic and supporting business growth.


#### **Key Responsibilities**


* Keyword Research: SEO Executives identify the most effective keywords for content and website optimization by analyzing search volume, competition, and user intent using tools like Google Keyword Planner, SEMrush, or Ahrefs. This research informs content strategy and helps target the right audience at the right time.
* On\-Page SEO: They optimize website elements such as title tags, meta descriptions, headings, image alt texts, and internal linking. Ensuring a responsive, user\-friendly layout and proper keyword placement improves both search engine rankings and user experience.
* Technical SEO: SEO Executives manage backend website elements to enhance crawlability and indexing. Tasks include fixing crawl errors, improving site speed, managing redirects, ensuring mobile responsiveness, and implementing schema markup for better visibility.
* Content Collaboration: They work closely with content writers, designers, and marketers to create SEO\-friendly content that aligns with search intent, engages users, and drives conversions. This includes optimizing blogs, landing pages, and product pages.
* Off\-Page SEO and Link Building: Building high\-quality backlinks and improving website authority are key responsibilities. SEO Executives evaluate link opportunities and monitor competitor strategies to strengthen the site’s credibility.
* Analytics and Reporting: Monitoring website performance using tools like Google Analytics, they track traffic, rankings, and other KPIs. They produce reports and provide actionable recommendations to improve SEO outcomes.
* Continuous Learning and Strategy Adjustment: SEO is dynamic, so executives must stay updated on search engine algorithm changes and industry trends, adjusting strategies to maintain or improve rankings.
* Collaboration and Cross\-Functional Work: SEO Executives often coordinate with web developers, marketing teams, and digital strategists to ensure SEO best practices are implemented across all content and technical aspects of the website.

#### **Key Skills**


* SEO Analysis
* Keyword Research
* Content Writing / Editing

**Role Objective**

The Social\-Political Content Researcher is responsible for identifying, analyzing, and contextualizing the most important political and social stories of the day. You won't just find the news; you will find the "story behind the story." Your research will fuel scripts for videos, long\-form articles, and social media campaigns that aim to inform and engage the public.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Trend Analysis:** Monitor legislative changes, election updates, and social movements to identify "viral" potential and civic importance.
* **Fact\-Checking \& Verification:** Cross\-reference political claims with official gazettes, parliamentary records (like Sansad TV/PRS), and historical data.
* **Narrative Building:** Transform complex policies (e.g., GST changes, New Education Policy) into simple, relatable content "hooks" for the creative team.
* **Data Visualization Support:** Gather statistics and "clean" data to help graphic designers create charts and infographics.
* **Sourcing Experts:** Identify and reach out to professors, activists, and analysts for exclusive quotes or deep\-dive interviews.
* **Archive Management:** Maintain a "Political Encyclopedia" of past speeches, manifesto promises, and flip\-flops for quick\-reference "then vs. now" content.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Educational Background:** Degree in Political Science, Sociology, Journalism, or Law.
* **Analytical Depth:** Ability to read between the lines of a government press release or a politician's tweet.
* **Platform Knowledge:** Mastery of Twitter (X), Instagram, and Reddit as research tools (understanding "Internet Culture").
* **Languages:** Native\-level fluency in **Hindi** and professional proficiency in **English** is mandatory. Knowledge of a regional language is a huge plus.
* **Tools:** Familiarity with Google Trends, TweetDeck, and basic data tools (Excel/Google Sheets).

**The Ideal Candidate**

* You follow the **Election Commission** and **Supreme Court** updates as closely as most people follow IPL.

* You can work under the "Breaking News" pressure where accuracy cannot be sacrificed for speed.

description:
**About Lokal :**
 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
   

  

 This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight \- when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

 Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
   

  

 to connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they've always deserved.
   

  

 We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
   

  

* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)
* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* Advisory Services \- early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more


 Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local\-language internet \+ deep Bharat insight\+ AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
   

  

 This is the story new teammates walk into:
   

  

 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.
   

  

 We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat. We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

OneMagnify interns are placed in teams across the business. Here are just a few teams that interns have joined in the past:

 Our client services, project management and planning teams immerse themselves in our clients’ business\- understanding their business strategies, goals and objectives. They work with each of the other OneMagnify core teams to ensure that we meet and exceed our clients’ marking objectives in ways that are strategically sound, intuitively smart, and drive measurable results.
   

  

**Analytics:** 
 The analytics division of OneMagnify, brings greater insight into business decisions for our clients by collecting, analyzing, and applying customer date in fresh, innovative ways. The team provides a full menu of analytic services, ranging from website analysis and performance monitoring, to social media analytics, and predictive modeling, to risk management and pricing analytics. These efforts drive insights that help our clients optimize their marketing initiative and achieve their objectives.
   

  

**Creative:** 
 Our highly versatile creative team is comprised of a variety of unique talents, at least two who are certifiable insane. From designers producing websites to copywriters crafting ad campaigns to creative service managers making sure it all gets done right, the creative team produces a full scope of both print and digital work for our clients\- including point and online advertising, websites, landing pages, direct mail, email, mobile, outdoor, point of sale, video production and social media content.
   

  

**Information Technology (IT):** 
 Our IT team is comprised of nearly 100 developers and systems administrators, each with specialties and expertise that enable us to deliver comprehensive and innovative technology solutions. We offer expertise in multiple platforms and environments including Oracle, SQL Server and MySQL, as well as Java, .Net and PHP. And, with 24/7 hardware and software monitoring and SAS 70, Type II certified datacenter, we are equipped to securely handle the most sensitive data for our clients.
   

  

**Application Management Services:** 
 Our application, management services team helps take the headaches our of administering some of our clients’ most complex programs – programs that require a level of support beyond the capabilities of their internal IR departments. From content and digital asset management systems to pricing solutions to marketing automation platforms, this team has the expertise to manage and optimize client business products and processes that support complex enterprise\-level applications.

 OneMagnify versatile and proficient Program Administration team administers dozens of programs concurrently for various OneMagnify clients, and has handled as many as 250,000 claims in 75\-day period (hey, do the math – that’s impressive). In addition to being on the frontlines as the Program Headquarters for these initiatives, the team provides services such as claims processing, check administration, mystery shopping, survey implementation, and inbound and outbound calling.

**Talent Management:** 
 Most companies call it “HR” but they’re not as cool as us. Our Talent Management department works hard to attract great talent, make OneMagnify a great place to work, and provide support in developing and managing our greatest assets – our people.

**Position: HRBP \- Associate (Based in Express Towers, Mumbai)** 




**Description:** 
 The HRBP\- Associate will be responsible for delivering proactive and high\-quality operational HR support to Jefferies India. The candidate will support the overall Jefferies India HR Head in providing a variety of HR services to the business. The HR Business Partner will act as a trusted advisor and will provide support to the business across the full range of HR disciplines such as recruitment including campus recruitment support, onboarding, performance management, compensation and benefits, regulatory reporting and audit requirements, employee relations, talent development and employee engagement.
 



  





**Primary Responsibilities:** 
 The HRBP Associate will report to the Jefferies India HR Head. Responsibilities include the following across JIPL (India front office) and JISPL (Mumbai Services entity) :
 



  




* Act as the primary HR Business Partner across various parts of the organization offering mentorship coordination, career development support, and serving as their main point of HR contact.
* Provide operational support to the India HR team across cyclical and ad hoc HR processes, including performance management, promotions, compensation, and talent development.
* Respond to employee and manager inquiries with accurate, timely, and thorough guidance on topics such as policies, immigration and employment verifications.
* Support the recruitment and campus teams to hire top talent, compensation proposals in line with market, head count approval management and support campus on the ground with Superday activities etc.
* Maintain data integrity by ensuring HR systems are updated accurately and promptly.
* Generate and manage HR analytics reports covering headcount, hiring, terminations, recruiting metrics, and other key data points.
* Support the onboarding and offboarding process for both voluntary and involuntary terminations.
* Proactively support HR regulatory filings plus audits and collaborate with various teams to maintain compliance with local regulatory requirements
* Foster cultural engagement by helping organize team\-building events and volunteer initiatives to strengthen cross\-team connectivity.
* Conduct new hire check\-ins to facilitate integration, address challenges, and gather feedback on the employee experience.
* Help drive the year\-end promotions process by managing timelines, tracking global nominations, compiling year\-over\-year statistics, and overseeing communications.
* Manage employee relations cases as required in partnership with HR management and employment legal counsel.
* Identify and recommend process improvements to enhance operational efficiency, escalating issues as needed based on day\-to\-day transactional insights.



  





**Desired Experience/Skills:** 



* Bachelor’s degree required, master’s degrees in human resources, psychology, or related fields preferred.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Strong Excel skills required (must be fluent in formulas such as VLOOKUP, PivotTables, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, MIN, MAX, AVERAGE).
* Comfortable learning and navigating systems; prior experience with HRIS is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Precise attention to detail and strong process orientation and project management skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a client service mindset.
* Positive attitude with a desire to learn and grow.
* Demonstrates sound judgment, professionalism and assertiveness with the ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Collaborative team player who takes initiative and proactively contributes ideas and recommendations.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-intensity work environment.



  





 At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives.  Manage exceptions and corrections in coordination with TA, HRBPs, and business stakeholders.

 Ensure audit\-ready documentation and approvals for all offers.
   

  

**Onboarding and Payroll\-readiness**
 Own end\-to\-end onboarding execution from pre\-joining to Day 1 readiness.
   

  

 Ensure support to the onboardees with completion of pre\-joining steps and the onboarding form.
   

  

 Ensure validation of key personnel information (like NationalIDs, Bank Accounts details etc. before activation).
   

  

 Enable zero\-defect payroll readiness for all onboarded employees within the first cycle.
   

  

 Track and resolve onboarding drop\-offs, no\-shows, and delayed activations in coordination with TA and business teams.
   

  

 Drive process improvements and automation to support rapid scale without compromising compliance or data accuracy.

 Ensure alignment of BGV initiation and closure with onboarding and payroll timelines.
   

  

 Review BGV dashboards, risks, and escalations; intervene where required to protect joining and compliance outcomes.

 Proactively flag risks impacting joining volumes, payroll readiness, or compliance.
   

  

 Ensure all early lifecycle processes comply with internal policies, approval frameworks, statutory requirements and data privacy standards
   

  

 Maintain audit\-ready documentation and trackers.
   

  

 Support internal and external audits related to hiring and onboarding.

 Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and standardise exit and benefits processes.
   

  

 Partner with HRIS, payroll systems, and internal tech teams to:
   

  

 Reduce manual interventions
   

  

 Improve data accuracy
   

  

 Enable real\-time tracking and reporting
   

  

 Build scalable workflows to support sustained high\-volume operations.

 Lead and guide a team of Onboarding Specialists
   

  

 Allocate work, manage capacity, and ensure consistent output quality.
   

  

 Regular reviews, coaching, and issue resolution to maintain operational discipline.
   

  

 Drive standardisation of SOPs, trackers, checklists and escalation mechanisms.
