 At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future\-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.
   

  

 Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.
   

  

**At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity:**
 Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team
   

  

**About the role :**
 As a Business Analyst in the Donor Information System (DIS) space within the Plasma\-Derived Therapies (PDT) business unit, you will independently serve as a bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams. You will collaborate closely with multiple stakeholders, determine requirements, translate business needs into effective technical solutions, maintaining continuous dialogue with all teams to ensure robustness, accuracy and consistency.
   

  

 By gathering requirements and facilitating cross\-team communication between business and IT teams, this role directly contributes to PDT’s ability to harness data effectively, enhancing decision\-making capabilities, and ultimately, competitive advantage in the market. You will be adopting cutting\-edge technologies and methodologies which will help Takeda drive innovation, adapt to new opportunities, and continuously evolve in an ever\-changing business/technological landscape.
   

  

 This position will align to Functional Analysis chapter of the ICC and initially report to the Functional Delivery Lead for strategic direction as well as day\-to\-day management until the role of BA Lead is filled within Takeda ICC, post which the reporting and managerial responsibilities will be transitioned accordingly.
   

  

**How you will contribute :**
* Contribute to the execution team by proactively clarifying requirements, identifying gaps, and escalating risks.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Senior Business Analysts and product stakeholders to ensure functional expectations are understood and delivered.
* Act as a reliable communication link between developers, testers, Quality, and business SMEs.
* Lead requirement‑gathering discussions for low–to–moderately complex features, including understanding user needs, non‑functional requirements, and pain points.
* Analyze requirements and document them into clear, structured artifacts such as Epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflows.
* Create and maintain needed documentation as BRD/FRD, Process flows/ workflow diagrams, Data mapping, interface specifications, integration requirements (APIs, middleware, data mapping)
* Perform functional acceptance of completed user stories and validate that the testcases and overall testing coverage meet the quality standards. Support refinement sessions by validating technical feasibility with development teams.
* Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, and story grooming sessions
* Highlight/identify gaps in existing functionality/user requirements.
* Conduct gap analysis, process mapping, and impact assessments for new enhancements.
* Support and contribute to user acceptance testing (UAT) efforts, including test case development, test execution, issue resolution, and assist in triaging functional defects.
* Liaise with different stakeholders including the client/business owner, project manager, solution architect, developers, testers and validators to ensure timely delivery of items and alignment on system changes
* Understand the business justification for the product, client’s vision, and future scope.
* Create functional design documents and other documentation required as part of GxP documentation process and work closely with the Quality and Validation teams ensuring timely approvals are obtained.
* Ensure documentation remains audit‑ready, consistent, and aligned with development and Quality expectations.
* Maintain Confluence spaces with updated feature details, design notes, and process artifacts.
* Support test case preparation through creation of test scenarios and acceptance tests that align with documented requirements.
* Assist with UAT planning and coordinate with business users to validate feature readiness.
* Perform initial root‑cause assessment for functional issues by reviewing logs, data, and workflows.
* Work closely with developers and architects to define technical solutions and clarify requirements
* Use SQL queries to validate data behavior, troubleshoot inconsistencies, and verify system outputs.
* Partner with the validation team throughout the validation lifecycle to clarify functional requirements, address queries and drive timely resolution of validation findings and issues.
* Provide structured issue documentation for senior analysts and developers.
* Support creation of change rationale and impact assessments for changes within your scope.
* Ensure compliance with change control and validation requirements, especially for GxP systems.
* Collaborate extensively across the organization, keep abreast of industry trends, continuously learn and adapt to new tools and techniques, and contribute to process improvement efforts.


**Minimum Requirements/Qualifications :**
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field is required
* 3\-5 years of experience working as Business Analyst/Product Owner, with a focus on gathering requirements and designing solutions.
* Hands\-on experience using
+ Jira
+ Confluence
+ MSSQL
+ MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
+ Figma

* Strong end\-to\-end BA skills gathering, analyzing and documenting business and system requirements.
* Understanding of requirements, use cases, and specification for features
* Translation of requirements into technical specifications.
* Familiarity with project management methodologies and tools
* Expertise in Agile (incl. PI Planning, Roadmap Development, Backlog Prioritization etc) and product Mindset \& Analytical Skillset
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with stakeholders at all levels
* Strong knowledge of
 **Agile/Scrum methodology:** 
 and SDLCExperience in change management
* Self\-motivated, with the ability to work independently and handle multiple tasks effectively
* Highly organized; able to break down complex problems and set priorities
* Strong relationship building and team collaboration skills


**Preferred requirements :**
* Regulatory knowledge such as change control processes related to GXP systems including the ability to create and manage change controls to ensure compliance, GXP documentation process and experience in drafting detailed documentation for Verification and Validation cycle.
* Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure)
* Familiarity with DevOps Practices (CI/CD pipelines)
* Experience with advanced prototyping tools such as Figma
* Experience working with diverse teams including IT, product owners, Quality and external vendors to ensure successful project outcomes.
* Strong understanding of GxP requirements and documentation management.
* Hands\-on experience providing support for validation testing and resolving issues that arise during the process.
* Ability to query databases for relevant data requests and evaluations


**BENEFITS:**
 It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career. Amongst our benefits are
   

  

* Competitive Salary \+ Performance Annual Bonus
* Flexible work environment, including hybrid working
* Comprehensive Healthcare Insurance Plans for self, spouse, and children
* Group Term Life Insurance and Group Accident Insurance programs
* Employee Assistance Program
* Broad Variety of learning platforms

description:
**Description**
 re you passionate about automation, designing processes, simplifying work and launching innovative products technology?
   

  

 We are looking for a Big Data Application Engineering Manager who will lead a team of Big Data Application Engineers and have the ability to deep dive into systems and invent and simplify with a high degree of ownership.
   

  

 Impact
   

  

 Ever wondered how Amazon offers the Earth's biggest selection and still manages to offer lower prices every day to our customers? Our retail business teams work with a massive array of vendors and business financial performance metrics to expand selection and drive costs lower. Given the rapid growth of our business, this requires our category leaders, financial analysts, site merchandisers and vendor managers to quickly analyze vendors, categories and brands, diving deep into data showing business efficiency down to the unit sale level. The technology that enables this has huge visibility and impact and is critical to Amazon's continued profitability and growth.
   

  

 Innovation
   

  

 We're working on the future. If you are seeking an environment where you can drive innovation. If you want to apply state\-of\-the\-art software technologies to solve real world problems. If you want the satisfaction of providing visible benefit to end\-users in an iterative fast paced environment, this is your opportunity. The responsibilities of this role will be key in paving the future of Amazon Retail and transforming how we do business.
   

  

 Opportunity
   

  

 You will be part of a team of creative, top\-notch engineers who work hard, have fun, and make history.
   

  

 This role is on the Chronicle team within Selling Partner Services. We own the Turismo product suite, which is powered by Ripple, a dynamic query engine. Turismo is a well loved product, with 15k\+ users globally. Ripple is a PrestoDB based query engine that is built to scale, and processes 2M\+ queries per week. We are a full stack team, with Product managers, UX designers, TPMs, SDEs, DEs and Data Scientists.
   

  

 We are seeking a Business Analyst who Owns the We are seeking a Business Analyst who will own the comprehensive metrics framework and metadata repository, serving as the central point of accountability for metric definitions, relationships, and data quality across business domains. This role acts as the primary liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders, diving deep into customer inquiries to translate complex data questions into actionable insights while maintaining rigorous documentation of metric lineage and business context.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Respond to customer questions across 12\+ external and internal surfaces where Ripple metrics are used by Selling Partners and internal Amazonians, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of data inquiries
   

  

 Develop deep expertise in the Ripple tech stack and conduct thorough deep dives into complex data issues, identifying root causes and providing comprehensive analysis
   

  

 Write complex SQL queries and Python scripts to extract, transform, and analyze data from petabyte\-scale data warehouses with a focus on query efficiency and performance optimization
   

  

 Automate recurring deep dive analyses to enable customer self\-service for frequently asked questions, reducing manual effort and improving response times
   

  

 Own and maintain metadata in the Metric Knowledge Service (MKS), ensuring accuracy, completeness, and accessibility of metric definitions and relationships
   

  

 Partner effectively with Product Managers and Selling Partners through excellent written and verbal communication, translating technical concepts into business language
   

  

 Leverage expert proficiency in SQL, Excel, ETL processes, and data visualization tools (QuickSight, Power BI, or similar platforms) to transform raw data into actionable insights
   

  

 Define business requirements and use data and metrics to draw meaningful insights that inform strategic initiatives
   

  

 Manage large datasets while conducting advanced statistical analyses to support business decisions
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
* 5\+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* 3\+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience with Excel
* Experience with SQL
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in e\-commerce
* Experience in working with Redshift, Apache Spark, or AWS Athena

title: Business Analyst – FinTech / Payments Domain
description:
**Company Description**
 Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.
   

  

 By combining world\-class engineering, industry expertise and a people\-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.
   

  

 From prototype to real\-world impact \- be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Business Analysis \& Requirements Management
   

  

 Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for new and existing payment products or platforms.
   

  

 Translate business objectives into detailed functional specifications, user stories, and process flows.
   

  

 Conduct gap analysis and recommend scalable, regulatory\-compliant solutions in the payments space.
   

  

 Partner with technology teams to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and implemented effectively.
   

  

 Validate solutions through user acceptance testing (UAT) and ensure alignment with business goals.
   

  

 Payments \& FinTech Domain Expertise
   

  

 Analyze and design workflows for various payment processing systems — including card payments, digital wallets, ACH, SWIFT, RTP, and instant payments.
   

  

 Understand payment gateways, merchant acquiring, switching, and settlement processes.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations such as PCI DSS, PSD2, ISO 20022, and local payment regulations.
   

  

 Collaborate with risk, compliance, and fraud teams to incorporate KYC/AML requirements into product design.
   

  

 Support product managers in designing innovative financial solutions, such as embedded payments, open banking APIs, and cross\-border remittances.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Experience:
   

 6–10 years
   

  

 We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Business Analyst with strong experience in the FinTech industry, particularly in the payments domain. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions, working closely with product, engineering, and operations teams to deliver high\-impact financial and digital payment products.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Core Competencies
   

  

 6\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in FinTech, Banking, or Payments.
   

  

 Strong understanding of payment systems, transaction lifecycles, and settlement processes.
   

  

 Experience with requirements gathering, UML modeling, use case diagrams, and workflow documentation.
   

  

 Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies; experience working with tools like JIRA, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
   

  

 Familiarity with APIs, microservices, and data integration concepts in payment systems.
   

  

 Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
   

  

 Technical \& Domain Knowledge
   

  

 Knowledge of card networks (Visa, MasterCard, Amex) and real\-time payment systems.
   

  

 Understanding of open banking, tokenization, and digital identity frameworks.
   

  

 Exposure to banking\-as\-a\-service (BaaS), payment orchestration, or merchant onboarding platforms is an advantage.
   

  

 SQL or data querying skills for transaction analysis (nice to have).
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 At Endava, we’re committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Software Engineer - Backend (5-7 years), Pune
description:
**About PhonePe Limited:**
 Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016\. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40\+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
   

  

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.
   

  

**Culture:**
 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Challenges**
 Building for Scale, Rapid Iterative Development, and Customer\-centric Product Thinking at each step defines every day for a developer at PhonePe. Though we engineer for a 50million\+ strong user base, we code with every individual user in mind. While we are quick to adopt the latest in Engineering, we care utmost for security, stability, and automation. Apply if you want to experience the best combination of passionate application development and product\-driven thinking
   

  

**As a Software Engineer:**
* You will build Robust and scalable web\-based applications You will need to think of platforms \& reuse
* Build abstractions and contracts with separation of concerns for a larger scope
* Drive problem\-solving skills for high\-level business and technical problems.
* Do high\-level design with guidance; Functional modeling, break\-down of a module
* Do incremental changes to architecture: impact analysis of the same
* Do performance tuning and improvements in large scale distributed systems
* Mentor young minds and foster team spirit, break down execution into phases to bring predictability to overall execution
* Work closely with Product Manager to derive capability view from features/solutions, Lead execution of medium\-sized projects
* Work with broader stakeholders to track the impact of projects/features and proactively iterate to improve them As a senior software engineer you must have
* Extensive and expert programming experience in at least one general programming language (e.g. Java, C, C\+\+) \& tech stack to write maintainable, scalable, unit\-tested code.
* Experience with multi\-threading and concurrency programming
* Extensive experience in object\-oriented design skills, knowledge of design patterns, and huge passion and ability to design intuitive module and class\-level interfaces
* Excellent coding skills – should be able to convert the design into code fluently
* Knowledge of Test Driven Development
* Good understanding of databases (e.g. MySQL) and NoSQL (e.g. HBase, Elasticsearch, Aerospike, etc)
* Strong desire to solving complex and interesting real\-world problems
* Experience with full life cycle development in any programming language on a Linux platform

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
Senior Product Analyst \- AI \& Automation


**Location:** Hyderabad
  

**Pattern of Work:** Hybrid
  

**Reporting to:** Senior Manager – AI \& Automation Products


**Note:** This role requires flexibility to collaborate across geographies and time zones, working with stakeholders in the UK and other global locations.


**About the Role**

We are seeking an proactive technical Product Analyst to join our growing AI \& Automation team within Enterprise Technology. You will play a pivotal role in scaling AI adoption across the organisation by serving as the critical bridge between internal business stakeholders and our Enterprise Tech Delivery, Architecture and Engineering teams.
  

You will own the Technical Discovery process—taking high\-level business problems from Flutter brands and functions such as Finance, Legal, Procurement, Tech and HR, and translating them into robust, platform\-centric technical specifications. You will focus on how our AI platforms (APIs, model orchestration, and AI \& Automation frameworks) can be leveraged to create scalable, secure, and high\-impact and high\-value internal solutions that can be shared and utilised across all Flutter brands and global divisions.


**What You'll Do**

  

**Technical Product Discovery \& Design**

* **PRD Ownership:** Lead the creation of comprehensive **Product Requirement Documents (PRDs)** that translate business objectives into clear technical specifications for the engineering teams.
* **Proactive Opportunity Mapping:** Use your initiative to identify friction points within internal functions and propose AI solutions that address underlying technical challenges.
* **Scalable Capability Building:** Ensure stakeholder requests are designed as modular platform capabilities that can be **leveraged across the entire global organisation** , avoiding isolated or one\-off solutions.

**Communication \& Strategic Reporting**

* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Maintain consistent, proactive communication with business leads and management, ensuring they understand the technical roadmap, progress, and how AI solutions solve their specific challenges.
* **Product Value Reporting:** Create and deliver updates to management on project outcomes, focusing on benefits realisation, productivity gains, and the strategic impact of platform features.
* **Show \& Tell Sessions:** Lead product demos and showcase sessions for internal stakeholders to drive awareness, gather feedback, and encourage adoption of AI capabilities.

**Technical Alignment \& Delivery Collaboration**

* **Backlog Refinement:** Own the "Definition of Ready." You ensure user stories are technically robust and logically sound, allowing the engineering team to focus on development without facing requirement gaps.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure the technical solution aligns with their original intent, providing clarity on product value and functional trade\-offs.
* **Dependency Identification:** Identify and document technical dependencies between the AI platform and existing internal systems to ensure smooth integration and prevent development delays.

**Governance, Quality \& Responsible AI**

* **Responsible AI Guardrails:** Incorporate ethics, security, and privacy requirements directly into the technical product specifications by design.
* **Validation \& UAT:** Define technical acceptance criteria and oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure the platform output is fit for purpose and achieves the intended productivity gains.

**Continuous Improvement**

* **Stay informed** on AI trends, platform engineering best practices, and agentic AI capabilities
* **Contribute** to the evolution of our operating model, engagement processes, and value frameworks.

**About You**

**Essential:**

* **Self\-Driven Approach:** You are high\-agency and proactive. You don't wait for instruction; you navigate the organisation to gather information and define the best path forward.
* **Technical Product Background:** 4\-6 years of experience delivering platform or data\-centric products You excel at translating ambiguous customer asks into tangible delivery tokens that can be handed off to engineering teams. You have shipped products to production and can demonstrate working knowledge of AI tools and platforms.

**Our Blueprint (Company Overview)**



At Madison Logic, we turn buyer uncertainty into confident action. Using data\-driven insights and strategic expertise, we help marketers align every decision\-maker, in every buying group, at every stage of the journey. We meet buyers wherever they are, navigating today’s non\-linear decision paths to keep marketers ahead. By combining data\-rich strategy with multi\-channel activation, we show B2B marketers and their agency partners not just what works, but why it works, so growth is accelerated with clarity and purpose.



“When ambitious marketers connect with their most elusive buyers to achieve ambitious growth targets, something extraordinary happens.”



“It’s not magic. It’s not *just* logic. It’s **Madison Logic**.”



  

**Built for Belonging (Why You'll Love Working Here)**



Here’s why you’ll love working here:


* **Access to competitive compensation \& benefits** that reward your contributions.
* **Participation in employee recognition programs** to celebrate achievements big and small.
* **Exposure to professional development \& learning initiatives** to help you build your own path.
* **Foundation built on values** anchored in Accountability, Team, Urgency, Respect, Integrity, and Innovation.
* **Opportunities for global exposure** work alongside talented colleagues across India, Singapore, the UK, and the US, expanding your perspective and network.
* **Invitations to yearly team offsites** to connect, collaborate, and strengthen relationships in person.
* **Leverage a lifestyle spending account benefit** so you can choose your own wellness and work\-from\-home perks.


Our commitment to you:


* **Our aspiration:** A culture where every person feels confident navigating their unique path and inspired to grow every step of the way.
* **Our support**: Meeting you where you are, empowering your growth with clarity, support, and purpose.
* **Our promise**: Your growth is yours to lead, but never a journey you take alone.
 **Job Summary:**



The Systems Specialist will be responsible for owning and managing multiple internal systems and tools used across the organization. This role will ensure systems are properly maintained, audited, updated, and supported throughout the employee lifecycle, including onboarding and offboarding. The individual will also support system implementations, scheduling processes, and act as primary support for key productivity and collaboration platforms.


**Responsibilities:**


***Systems Ownership \& Administration:***


* Own and manage various internal systems and applications, ensuring accuracy, security, and reliability.
* Perform regular system audits, updates, and access reviews.
* Maintain system documentation, processes, and controls.


***Onboarding \& Offboarding:***


* Support employee onboarding by provisioning system access, tools, and permissions.
* Manage offboarding processes, ensuring timely deactivation of access and compliance with security policies.
* Coordinate closely with HR, IT, and People Operations teams.


***System Implementations \& Improvements:***


* Support the implementation of new systems and tools, including testing, configuration, and rollout.
* Partner with internal stakeholders and vendors to ensure successful adoption.
* Identify opportunities for system improvements and process automation.


***Scheduling \& Calendar Management:***


* Support scheduling needs and manage company\-wide calendars.
* Provide administrative support for Outlook calendars and scheduling tools.
* Assist with meeting coordination across teams and time zones.


***Application \& Tool Support:***



Act as primary support for the following tools (or similar platforms):


* UKG Ready
* WorkRamp
* Gong
* Outlook
* Hello (or HelloSign / Hello\-related tools, if applicable)
* Zoom
* Snapbar


**Responsibilities include:**


* User support and troubleshooting
* Access management
* Basic configuration and setup
* Vendor coordination as needed


**Compliance \& Auditing:**


* Support internal and external audits related to systems and access controls.
* Ensure systems are compliant with company policies and data protection standards.

  


**Required Qualifications:**


* 2\+ years of experience in systems administration, HR systems, IT operations, or a related role.
* Hands\-on experience supporting multiple SaaS tools and internal systems.
* Strong understanding of user access management, onboarding, and offboarding processes.
* Experience with scheduling tools, calendars, and collaboration platforms.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience supporting HRIS, LMS, CRM, or enablement tools.
* Familiarity with audit processes and access controls.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced or scaling organization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  


**Salary Range:**


* Fixed CTC: 12,00,000 \- 13,00,000 INR

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Who we are:**  

At Johnson Controls we transform the environments where people live, work, learn and play. As the global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. With a history of more than 135 years of innovation, Johnson Controls delivers the blueprint of the future for a wide range of industries through its comprehensive digital offering OpenBlue. With a global team of 100,000 experts in more than 150 countries, Johnson Controls offers the world\`s largest portfolio of building technology, software as well as service solutions with some of the most trusted names in the industry. For more information, visit www.johnsoncontrols.com or follow us @johnsoncontrols on Twitter.  

  

**What you will do:**  

We are looking for a proactive and collaborative **Talent Acquisition Specialist** to drive full‑cycle hiring . In this role, you’ll partner closely with business leaders, hiring managers, and HR stakeholders to attract top talent, strengthen our employer brand, and create an exceptional candidate experience.

 **How you will do it:**

### **1\. End\-to\-End Recruitment**

* Manage full‑cycle recruiting across functions (sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management).
* Understand hiring needs, create job descriptions, and recommend sourcing strategies tailored to each role.
* Conduct competency‑based interviews and coordinate interview panels.

### **2\. Sourcing \& Talent Pipeline Development**

* Build and maintain active talent pipelines using job boards, professional networks, referrals, and social recruiting.
* Leverage platforms like Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, and industry groups to identify high\-quality talent.
* Engage and nurture passive candidates for future requirements.

### **3\. Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a consultative partner to business leaders on market insights, hiring timelines, and talent availability.
* Provide regular updates, dashboards, and status reports to stakeholders.
* Manage alignment meetings, debrief discussions, and offer approvals.

### **4\. Candidate Experience \& Employer Branding**

* Deliver a seamless and positive experience from application to onboarding.
* Represent the organization professionally at all candidate touchpoints.
* Support employer branding initiatives for local talent markets.

### **5\. Offer Management \& Compliance**

* Drive salary negotiations, offer creation, and pre‑joining engagement.
* Ensure compliance with company hiring guidelines and India employment regulations.
* Work closely with HR Ops, background verification teams, and onboarding partners.

### **6\. Recruitment Data \& Process Excellence**

* Maintain accurate data in ATS systems.
* Track metrics such as TAT, source mix, pipeline ratios, and candidate conversion.
* Identify opportunities to improve recruitment processes, tools, and overall efficiency.
* Compile, analyze data and metrics to support business decisions and plans as necessary.
* Development of Talent Pipeline for Diversity and Inclusion (D\&I) Initiatives and future needs.
* Act as a brand ambassador leveraging a multi\-channel strategy, in partnership with Talent Brand \& Communications to promote our Employer Value Program (EVP) in the target market.

  

  

**What we look for:**

* 5\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting experience in preferably into commercial hiring
* Strong experience in sourcing related activities to help drive talent into the organization
* Demonstrated ability to build recruiting strategy, employer branding, candidate management, talent sourcing with emphasis on diversity and inclusion.
* Strong skills in talent research and sourcing, social media recruiting and other techniques to identify and engage with talent.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
* Excellent communication skills – written and verbal.
* Proven experience with LinkedIn sourcing, both passive and active

description:
**Job Title**: .NET Developer

**Organization:** National Informatics Centre (NIC)  
**Location:** Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir, India  
**Department:** e\-Governance / Software Development  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time / Contract

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a skilled **.NET Developer** to join the development team at NIC Jammu. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining web applications and e\-Governance solutions using Microsoft .NET technologies. The role requires collaboration with cross\-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure digital services for government stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance **web applications using .NET technologies**.
* Design and implement **ASP.NET / .NET Core based applications**.
* Work on **front\-end integration using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like Angular or React**.
* Develop and manage **RESTful APIs and Web Services**.
* Perform **database design, development, and optimization using SQL Server**.
* Ensure **application security, performance, and scalability**.
* Participate in **code reviews, debugging, and troubleshooting**.
* Collaborate with project managers, system analysts, and stakeholders for requirement analysis.
* Maintain **technical documentation and deployment procedures**.
* Support **existing government applications and portals** developed by NIC.

**Required SkillsTechnical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **C\# and .NET Framework / .NET Core**
* Experience with **ASP.NET MVC / Web API**
* Proficiency in **Microsoft SQL Server**
* Experience with **Entity Framework / LINQ**
* Knowledge of **HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript**
* Familiarity with **Git or version control systems**
* Experience with **REST APIs and microservices architecture**

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with **Angular / React**
* Knowledge of **Azure or cloud deployment**
* Understanding of **government e\-Governance platforms**
* Familiarity with **CI/CD pipelines**

**Qualifications**

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s degree** in Computer Science, IT, or related field (B.Tech / MCA preferred).
* **2–5 years of experience** in .NET development (freshers with strong project experience may also be considered).

**Soft Skills**

* Strong **problem\-solving and analytical skills**
* Good **communication and teamwork abilities**
* Ability to work in **government project environments with deadlines**

Job Type: Contractual / Temporary

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month
